🔔  Reminders (CloudKit) — iPhone → Nextcloud Tasks
panels.description: Phase 6.1.5: EventKit-driven mirror of post-2018 CloudKit reminders that the legacy CalDAV endpoint can't see. Watcher daemon listens for EKEventStoreChangedNotification and debounces 10s before kicking the sync. ~25-35s end-to-end iPhone tap → Nextcloud Tasks.

panels.title: Watcher heartbeats (30m)
panels.description: event=alive heartbeat fires every 5min. Expect ~6 in 30m. <5 means missed beats; <3 means watcher dead.

panels.title: Kicks (24h)
panels.description: Each kick fires when EventKit signals a Reminders.app change. Bursts of edits debounce into one kick.

panels.title: Reminders synced (24h)
panels.description: event=synced fires after the script PUTs ≥1 changed/pushed/deleted reminder to Nextcloud.

panels.title: Activity (kicks + syncs)
panels.description: Kicks (watcher firing) and synced events (sync producing changes) over time.

panels.title: Reminders (CloudKit): recent events
panels.description: Combined sync + watcher events. Filter out 'started' for less noise.

panels.title: 🔖  Bookmarks (Safari) — iCloud → Nextcloud Bookmarks
panels.description: Phase 6.2: mirrors ~/Library/Safari/Bookmarks.plist (which Apple keeps in lock-step with iCloud Bookmarks via CloudKit) into the Nextcloud Bookmarks app. Event-driven via launchd WatchPaths on ~/Library/Safari, with a 6h StartInterval safety net. Manifest-diffs by SHA so unchanged bookmarks aren't re-PUT.

panels.title: Successful runs (12h)
panels.description: At least 1 expected per 12h via the 6h fallback timer alone. Red = sync stuck or daemon dead.

panels.title: Bookmarks pushed (24h)
panels.description: New bookmarks created in Nextcloud over the last 24h.

panels.title: Bookmarks changed (24h)
panels.description: Bookmarks updated (URL or title or description changed) in last 24h.

panels.title: Bookmarks: recent events
panels.description: All sync events. Filter out 'started' for less noise.

panels.title: 📝  Notes (Apple) — iCloud → Nextcloud Notes
panels.description: Phase 6.3: parses ~/Library/Group Containers/group.com.apple.notes/NoteStore.sqlite (snapshot-copy approach because Notes.app holds an exclusive lock), decodes gzip+protobuf note bodies, pushes to the Nextcloud Notes app. AppleScript path is unworkable (-1712 timeouts on CloudKit-backed notes, same wall as Reminders). Event-driven via WatchPaths on the Group Containers dir + 6h fallback timer.

panels.description: ≥1 expected per 12h via the 6h safety net alone. Red = sync stuck or daemon dead.
